Describe the change and affected lesson or page.

For lesson contributions:
- [ ] Include the intended students, preparation, and learning objectives.
- [ ] Include editable originals, source credits, and image descriptions.
- [ ] State what was tested, including software and hardware versions.
- [ ] Check the preview with the author and an educator before publication.

For maintainers:
- [ ] Check the build, links, accessibility structure, and sentence lengths.
- [ ] Keep published lesson addresses stable.
- [ ] Confirm the checked build passes before publishing from `main`.
